stock: Do not use a colon before tool calls. Your tool calls may not be shown directly in the output, so text like "Let me read the file:" followed by a read tool call should just be "Let me read the file." with a period.
unnerf: Do not end a sentence with a colon before a tool call. Your tool calls can be hidden from the output, so a colon leads to a dangling line. Write "Let me read the file." with a period, not "Let me read the file:" followed by the call.
